american-idiot.Este projeto nasceu da proposta de criar: This project began with the proposal to create a new cover for Green Day’s American Idiot, visually reinterpreting the critiques in the album. The starting point was to question the American Dream and the way American society and culture are portrayed.
american-idiot.A estética busca traduzir a energia inte: The aesthetic translates the album’s intense, provocative energy into a bold composition, exploring visual elements associated with rebellion, dissatisfaction and social alienation. Typography and textures reinforce this atmosphere, creating a visual identity that echoes the songs’ defiant character.
american-idiot.O projeto procura transformar essas crít: The project turns these critiques into a visual experience, using contrast and graphic intensity to represent the conflict between the American ideal and the reality presented in the album.
american-idiot.Assim, a nova capa funciona como uma ext: The new cover therefore extends the concepts in American Idiot, visually conveying the same sense of restlessness, criticism and rebellion that drives the album.

cortopassi.Minha identidade visual nasceu da relaçã: My visual identity grew out of my relationship with comics and geek culture, references that have always been part of my journey. Elements such as skulls and ghosts appeared early in the process, when I was beginning to develop my own visual language.
cortopassi.Em 2018, criei a conta @phantom_comics p: In 2018, I created @phantom_comics to publish my drawings anonymously and build a project from scratch. After leaving it aside for a while, I returned to the idea in 2023 with @phantom_comics_23, exploring different kinds of content. Over time, the account moved closer to design and became my space as a designer.
cortopassi.Hoje, o nome Phantom Comics já não repre: Today, the name Phantom Comics no longer fully represents this new chapter. The identity is therefore moving closer to my own name, reflecting this transformation while keeping the elements that belong to my story.
cortopassi.As referências aos quadrinhos, às caveir: The references to comics, skulls and ghosts remain as fragments of this journey, connecting the past to the present. More than a name change, this
cortopassi.nova identidade representa uma evolução:: new identity represents an evolution: a more personal, distinctive chapter connected to my work as a designer.

ama.Como projeto acadêmico de rebranding, tr: For this academic rebranding project, we partnered with the Associação de Amigos do Autista (AMA), an organization with more than 40 years of experience and an important legacy of care and inclusion for people on the autism spectrum.
ama.Diante de uma marca com uma história tão: Faced with a brand with such an established history, the challenge was to understand what should remain rather than start from scratch. We sought to translate its longstanding values into a more contemporary identity, able to connect with both the existing AMA community and new audiences.
ama.O projeto partiu de quatro pilares que r: The project began with four pillars that represent the organization’s essence: ethics, respect, loyalty and professionalism. From these, we developed an identity that balances subtle, geometric forms with more organic, welcoming elements.
ama.Mais do que atualizar a aparência da mar: Beyond updating the brand’s appearance, the proposal was to create an identity that inspires belonging. A brand that staff, beneficiaries and partners could feel proud of, while presenting AMA to corporate audiences with greater strength and relevance.
ama.O resultado é uma atualização que olha p: The result is an update that looks to the future while retaining its roots: a more contemporary identity that remains recognizable at its core, preserving what made AMA what it is.

alpargatas.Este projeto nasceu da proposta de criar: This project began with a proposal to create the visual identity of an innovation hub for Alpargatas, drawing on its origins and legacy. The starting point was Mooca, a neighborhood shaped by railway tracks, movement and work.
alpargatas.A estética foi construída a partir da me: The aesthetic was built around railway tracks as a metaphor for connection and transformation. Just as different routes can intersect and lead to new destinations, innovation emerges when ideas, people and possibilities meet.
alpargatas.O projeto busca representar esse movimen: The project represents this movement visually, creating an identity that can accompany different journeys and experiences within the hub. The tracks go beyond a physical route to symbolize discovery, learning and collective creation.
alpargatas.Assim, a identidade não funciona apenas: The identity is therefore more than a representation of the space: it is a system that values the process of innovation. Through routes, connections and new destinations, the project reinforces the idea that every journey helps build the future and leaves a legacy for those who follow.

kitkat.Como parte de um projeto de fins educati: As part of an educational project in partnership with Nestlé, we were challenged to experiment with the KitKat Moments line, with the freedom to rethink its name, identity and packaging.
kitkat.O briefing propunha a criação de um sist: The brief called for a complete product system: a stand-up pouch, three finger flavors and a chocolate bar, all connected by a new visual identity.
kitkat.A partir disso, decidimos olhar para o c: We began by looking at the brand’s best-known concept: the break. Rather than simply repeating the traditional idea of a pause, we sought to give this moment a new meaning, turning it into a more contemporary, playful experience specific to the line.
kitkat.Essa mudança deu origem a um novo nome e: This change led to a new name and brand personality, designed to connect with its audience in a more spontaneous, relevant way. At the same time, we preserved the essential elements that make KitKat recognizable, balancing familiarity and novelty.
kitkat.O resultado é uma releitura da marca que: The result is a reinterpretation of the brand that makes taking a break more expressive, inviting and visually striking: a new way to understand the famous break.

fragmin.Fragmin nasceu de um exercício de criaçã: Fragmin began as an exercise in creating a variable typeface built from a single grid. The starting point was fragmentation, the concept that also gave the project its name: different parts that, even when opposed, find a way to connect and form a harmonious visual system.
fragmin.A estética foi inspirada em uma ideia de: The aesthetic was inspired by the idea of a futuristic past, combining geometric structures, modular shapes and an experimental atmosphere. Each character was developed from fragments that can be rearranged, creating different possibilities within the same structure.
fragmin.O projeto foi desenvolvido em grupo, com: The project was developed as a group, with the challenge of ensuring that every version of the typeface used the same grid and could relate to the others. Using this system, we explored interpolation between shapes, allowing the fragments to transform fluidly and continuously.
fragmin.Assim, Fragmin não funciona apenas como: Fragmin is therefore more than a typeface with different versions: it is a system in constant transformation. Between one shape and another, new combinations, characters and visual possibilities emerge.
fragmin.O resultado é uma tipografia variável ex: The result is an experimental variable typeface that makes the construction of letters part of the experience: fragments that continuously come together, break apart and transform.

vizao.A VIZÃO é um projeto editorial acadêmico: VIZÃO is an academic editorial project developed around the theme of health, with a specific focus on climate anxiety. The magazine takes the form of a survival tutorial for the end of the world, offering a spiritual, cultural guide rooted in ancestral knowledge for young people facing the uncertainties of a future shaped by the climate crisis.
vizao.O projeto é fundamentado no conceito de: The project draws on Ailton Krenak’s concept of “Ancestral Future” and Ubuntu philosophy, bringing different temporalities and perspectives together to question the idea of a linear future. The magazine seeks to break through colonial boundaries and center Indigenous peoples throughout the Americas, valuing knowledge, stories and traditions that have historically been erased or silenced.
vizao.Visualmente, a identidade da VIZÃO busca: Visually, VIZÃO’s identity reinforces this connection to ancestry through a handmade, organic and craft-based language. The publication uses hand-drawn artwork, illustrations and graphic elements inspired by Brazilian Indigenous art. This approach moves away from a rigid digital aesthetic, bringing texture, imperfection and a more human quality to the publication.
vizao.A estrutura editorial da VIZÃO se organi: VIZÃO’s editorial structure has three axes: past, present and future. More than a timeline, they offer different paths for reflection: the past recovers ancestral knowledge and traditions; the present explores the issues and struggles finding a voice today; and the future proposes paths, provocations and possibilities for imagining new ways of living.
vizao.Mais do que informar sobre a crise climá: Beyond informing readers about the climate crisis, VIZÃO seeks to reconnect them with life, nature and ancestry. Its visual and editorial language looks to earlier knowledge to question the present and imagine new futures. It turns anxiety about the future into an invitation to reflect, connect and build other possibilities.

queluz.Como projeto acadêmico de embalagem, tra: For this academic packaging project, we worked with Fósforo Queluz, seeking to recover its history while creating an identity that could stand out in a market lacking originality and presence.
queluz.A principal inspiração para o projeto ve: The main inspiration came from Brazilian posters of the 1950s, exploring a vintage aesthetic shaped by the graphic communication of that period. From these references, we built a rich visual language using illustrations, drawings, halftones, screen patterns and graphic textures, alongside playful, expressive and dynamic typography. The aim was to create a composition full of movement and personality, recalling the popular, striking character of old posters.
queluz.A brasilidade também foi fundamental par: Brazilian cultural identity was also central to the design. We sought references that offered a visual interpretation of Brazilian culture rather than simply reproducing a retro aesthetic. Colors, illustrations, shapes and textures were combined to create packaging with its own identity and a closer connection to its audience.
queluz.O resultado é uma embalagem que combina: The result combines 1950s vintage style with a playful, dynamic and distinctly Brazilian graphic language. It transforms an everyday product into a visually striking piece, deliberately using a variety of graphic elements to give Fósforo Queluz personality and help it stand out at the point of sale.
